opening.argument: The strongest signal is the walkthrough itself: the speaker introduces a step-by-step airdrop tutorial and explicitly says the faucet tokens are testnet tokens, not real money. The screen shows a test-token faucet, Omnipact protocol options, and a MetaMask confirmation over an order page. The speaker also describes points for tasks, additional points for linking an X account and joining Discord, and BNB needed for gas. Those details make this an operational demonstration, not a promise of a financial outcome. The description expressly declines to guarantee any project's legitimacy, value, or success; the evidence does not establish that participation will produce a valuable reward.
